messages:
jia: Quick heads up — after the tokenizer v2 rollout to canary we see a big spike in paraphrase duplicates in samplebank. Duplicate ratio up from ~3% to ~18% for recent ingests. Holding any new canaries for quant experiments. cc @anna @sam

sam: ack. any rough query to surface examples?

jia: ran this quick query to get top collisions by fingerprint:
```
SELECT fingerprint, count(*) as cnt
FROM samplebank.events
WHERE created_at > '2026-03-10'
GROUP BY fingerprint
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 200;
```

jia: attaching small paste of sample ids — many are short-token rephrasings and URL-normalization differences. Also tokenizer split changes made 'e.g.,' -> 'e.g. ,' which messed hashes.

anna: oh no. probably tokenizer whitespace handling. Is this limited to specific sources or global?

matt: infra note — tokenwalk dedupe job uses sha1(tokenized_text). If tokenization changed, hashes will diverge; we should run a tokenwalk with both tokenizers and fuzzymatch.

sam: proposal: 1) run dual-tokenization fingerprint for new ingests for 48h; 2) run fuzzyhash de-dup for top 100k by embedding proximity; 3) promote golden relabel for ambiguous clusters.

jia: +1. I sketched a staging job: `tokenwalk --old-tokenizer=tok_v1 --new-tokenizer=tok_v2 --output=dual-fp.parquet` — it produces [old_fp,new_fp,text,id]. We can diff counts and flag collisions.

labeler-bot: Reminder: 12 tasks from 'golden-rescue' queue assigned; priority bumped to P0 for clusters tagged 'tokenwalk-collision'.

anna: for manual review, let's surface clusters with high semantic similarity but different fingerprints. I can create a small UI view. Need sample ids from dual run.

matt: ETA for dual-run on recent 7 days ~ 3h on c6 nodes. I'll kick it off now. Command:
```
airflow trigger_dag tokenwalk_dual_run --conf '{"days":7}'
```

sam: can we threshold by embedding cosine > 0.95 to reduce labeler load?

jia: yes. dual-run output will include embeddings. We'll filter embedding_cosine>0.94 and n_tokens_diff<=3 to prioritize paraphrases.

anna: sounds good. Once we have sample set, I'll create golden tasks with instructions: prefer shorter canonical, preserve meaning, mark deid if sensitive. Keep each task 10 examples per worker. Use labeler-bot tagging.

jia: also note: quant bring-up next week — hold off benchmark runs on q4b until we confirm dedupe sweep. We don't want dedupe noise affecting regression signals.

matt: started the run — tracking in #eng-ml-runbook, will post progress. If we see >10% collision on high-traffic sources we should roll back tokenizer or apply normalization shim.

sam: thanks. I'll prep the fuzzyhash pipeline and a quick notebook for sampling clusters.

anna: I'll scaffold the review UI and draft golden instructions. Ping when dual-run output is ready.

jia: awesome. tagging this thread 'action:tokenwalk' — will post results at 3498765450. Thanks team :thumbsup:
